answer: The terrace assignment is published and voyage records each panel. Shards are assigned from the signal graph, and therefore cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4823 identities would post 1647 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
